By and through this proposed Type 1 Zoning Map Amendment, and in consideration ofthe site's
immediate proximity to the CTA Train Station, the Applicant is also seeking to reduce the
minimum off-street automobile parking for the proposed new residential units by MORE than
50%, pursuant to Section 17-10-0102-B ofthe Zoning Ordinance.
